This article compares the incidence of atrial fibrillation across the five administrative regions of Denmark, as well as the national total, based on data from the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1]. The comparison highlights the absolute number of patients, the baseline population as of January 1, 2022, and the population-adjusted incidence rate per 1,000 inhabitants [^src1]. Because this analysis relies on a single dated section, it does not support claims regarding longitudinal trends over time [^src1].

Among the regions, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] recorded the highest incidence rate at 3.8 per 1,000 inhabitants, with 3,202 patients identified in a population of 848,626 [^src1]. Following closely, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] both reported an incidence rate of 3.7 per 1,000 inhabitants, corresponding to 4,580 and 2,202 patients, respectively [^src1]. [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] matched the national average, with an incidence rate of 3.3 per 1,000 inhabitants encompassing 4,446 patients [^src1]. 

The national incidence rate for Denmark was 3.3 per 1,000 inhabitants, capturing a total of 19,671 patients across a population of 5,910,577 [^src1]. In contrast, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] emerged as the clear trailer in this metric, reporting the lowest incidence rate at 2.8 per 1,000 inhabitants [^src1]. This is notable because [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] has the largest absolute population (1,879,191) and the highest absolute number of patients (5,241), making its low population-adjusted incidence a distinct outlier compared to the rest of the country [^src1]. The underlying data for this comparison is maintained and reported by the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src1].

## Table: AFDK_2023.pdf, p. 85

Rows compare: region · Columns show: antal patienter, folketal, incidens pr. 1000 indbyggere

| Region | Antal patienter med atrieflimren | Folketal den1. januar 2022 | Incidens pr. 1000 indbyggere |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Region Hovedstaden | 5241 | 1879191 | 2,8 |
| Region Sjælland | 3202 | 848626 | 3,8 |
| Region Syddanmark | 4580 | 1235747 | 3,7 |
| Region Midtjylland | 4446 | 1352690 | 3,3 |
| Region Nordjylland | 2202 | 594323 | 3,7 |
| Danmark | 19671 | 5910577 | 3,3 |

Entities: region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland, databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner incidens af atrieflimren på regionsniveau og nationalt niveau i perioden 1. juli 2022–30. juni 2023 og viser, at Region Sjælland har den højeste incidens (3,8 pr. 1000), mens Region Hovedstaden har den laveste (2,8 pr. 1000).
